|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Hatred''' is an [[aura]] [[active skill|skill]] that grants the user and allies extra [[cold damage]] based on their [[physical damage]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== * Hatred causes hits to gain a percentage of their physical damage as extra cold damage. This applies to all [[hit]]s: [[attack]], [[spell]], and [[secondary damage]]. It is a form of [[conversion]] and follows standard mechanics. * [[Proxies]] like [[trap]]s and [[totem]]s use your skill, which has your stats, including from buffs. Hatred has to affect the player; {{il|Generosity Support}} should not be used in this case. * [[Minion]]s and [[partying|party members]] are affected when they [[hit]] while within the [[range]] of the aura. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = % of Physical
Damage
as Cold |c1_header = You and nearby allies gain x% of Physical Damage as Extra Cold Damage |c1_pattern_extract = You and nearby allies gain (%d+)%% of Physical Damage as Extra Cold Damage |c1_pattern_value = %d%% |c2_abbr = Radius |c2_header = +x metres to radius |c2_pattern_extract = %+(%d+%.*%d*) metres? to radius |c2_pattern_value = +%sm }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Ruthless mode== Hatred cannot be obtained from [[quest]]s or traded for using an {{il|Uncarved Gemstone}} through [[Siosa]] in [[Ruthless mode]]. {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Hatred: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where = items.stat_text LIKE "%Hatred%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Related passive skills== The following [[passive skill]]s are related to Hatred: {{Passive skill table |q_where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Hatred%" |large=1 |stat=1 }} ==Related modifiers== The following [[modifier]]s are related to Hatred:
{{Query spawnable modifiers |where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%Hatred%" AND mods.generation_type NOT IN ("10", "29") AND mods.domain NOT IN ("30") |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |domain=1 |generation_type=1 }}
These Synthesis implicit are able to find in pre-[[synthesised item]] or added via [[Harvest]] mechanics: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%Hatred%" AND mods.id LIKE "%SynthesisImplicit%" |stat_text=1 |level=1 |domain=1 }} These Eater of Worlds implicit are able to find in pre-[[influenced item]] or added via Eater of Worlds currencies. Some high tier mod requires {{il|Orb of Conflict}} to craft: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%Hatred%" AND mods.generation_type = 29 |stat_text=1 |level=1 |spawn_weights=1 |q_orderBy=mods.id ASC }} The following mods can only be find in [[event]] leagues that [[Sentinel]] mechanic is active: {{Query spawnable modifiers |where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%Hatred%" AND mods.domain = "30" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 }} ===Legacy mods=== The following mods can only be find in legacy item in permanent leagues: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%Hatred%" AND mods.generation_type NOT IN ( "3", "10", "29", "30") |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |spawn_weights=1 }} Note that the legacy {{c|mod|#% increased Mana Reservation Efficiency}} function the same as the current mod, just the coding behind is different so that it is stored as negative value. Functionality in the official [https://www.pathofexile.com/trade/search trade site] has been fixed so that it can auto detect the item mod as either current mod and legacy mod, only in advanced mod description the item will show the mod as legacy. {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Hatred%" OR BINARY items.description LIKE "%Hatred%" OR items.description LIKE "%your aura%" OR BINARY items.name LIKE "Invisible Buff Effect" ) }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * No longer has causes you and nearby allies to deal more Cold Damage. * You and nearby allies now gain 30% of Physical Damage as Extra Cold Damage at gem level 1 (previously 16%), scaling up to 39% at gem level 20 (previously 25%). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Alternate quality gems, labyrinth helmet enchantments and unique threshold jewels are all systems that were trying to subtly modify the behaviour of skills. With this expansion these have been combined into a new system called Transfigured Gems that allows us to fully achieve the goal of these three systems, and then some. * Anomalous, Divergent and Phantasmal Quality Gems have been removed from the game. Existing alternate Quality Gems now have the base Quality effect found on the respective Gem. }} {{Version history table row|3.13.0| * Anomalous Hatred now grants you and nearby allies 0.25% increased chill and freeze duration per 1% gem quality (from 1% per 1% gem quality) * Divergent Hatred now grants you and nearby allies 0.25% increased movement speed while on chilled ground per 1% gem quality (from 1% per 1%). }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| * Now has alternate gem [[quality]]: Anomalous or Divergent. }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Now causes you and nearby Allies to deal 14% more Cold Damage at gem level 1, up to 18% more Cold Damage at gem level 20. Note that this cold damage multiplies the Extra damage granted by the aura. * Now causes you and nearby Allies to gain 16% of Physical Damage as Extra Cold Damage (from 26%) at gem level 1, up to 25% at gem level 20 (from 36%). }} {{Version history table row|3.4.0| * Now instant by default and can therefore be used while moving. * All instant skills now have cooldown 1 second or less. * Instant skills cannot be supported by Spell Echo and will not be cast a second time by similar effects (such as from the Echoing Shrine). }} {{Version history table row|1.0.0| * Mana reserved standardized to 60%. Damage increase has been increased. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.9| * Increased damage. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.8c| * Fixed Hatred to count as a cold gem. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.7| * Hatred has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}} [[Category:Buffs]]
